subject: English
question_text: Make five sentences using parts of sentences from each column of the table below.
stimulus: Education in our country Bangladesh is already a daily affair in Bangladesh Campus violence are getting concerned about only to be engaged in has almost become violence It seems that students in educational stage of crisis It is true that institutions are educationally backward The teachers and guardians is passing through a the welfare of the students
guide_solution: Producing sentences from a substitution table: (i) Education in our country is passing through a stage of crisis. (ii) Campus violence has almost become a daily affair in Bangladesh. (iii) It seems that students in educational institutions are only to be engaged in violence. (iv) It is true that Bangladesh is already educationally backward. (v) The teachers and guardians are getting concerned about the welfare of the students.
